      "content": "# Public AI interaction evidence\n\nThis appendix supplies **available recovered conversations**, not only an AI-use summary. It retains available student instructions, AI proposals, corrections, errors, code and recorded tool outcomes in source order, with the specific redactions in the register. Original languages are preserved; translating or rewriting the dialogue would alter the evidence. New explanatory material is in English.\n\n## Start here\n\n- [Contribution-to-message links](contribution_links.md): 31 locators supporting the ten activities in the [contribution summary](../contribution_summary.csv).\n- [Conversation index](conversation_index.csv): eleven ChatGPT conversations, three Codex session snapshots and one database-supplement notice. Each conversation has a README linking its numbered text parts.\n- [Record index](record_index.csv): available message/event anchors with links to the public parts.\n- [Redaction register](redactions.csv): one row for every removed span, with source character offsets, source text line, reason, replacement marker and public locator. Secret values and hashes of individual secrets are not published.\n- [Integrity manifest](manifest.json): source-view fingerprints, public fingerprints and ordered part lists.\n- [Source comparison](verification.json): recorded local comparison with all fifteen private source views.\n- [Publication procedure and limits](publication_procedure.md).\n\nThe numbered `.txt` parts keep large tool logs readable on GitHub. Numbers indicate sequence, not editorial versions. Concatenating the parts **without adding separators** reconstructs each public derivative exactly. Historical links, version names and references to private files are retained as spoken; they are not current project references or downloadable public attachments. The archived source header's word “private” describes that original, not this public derivative.\n\n## What was hidden\n\nThe register records **186 occurrences**: 5 password values, 5 literal password fragments in earlier checks, 68 access-token/signature values, 23 restricted course-recording/meeting URLs and 85 inline image payloads. Occurrences include repeated representations and quoted tool output; they are not counts of unique credentials or independent conversations. Image bytes can contain unreviewed screenshots, including login screens; their surrounding tool text remains. This appendix does not publish binary attachments, browser HTML envelopes, raw databases or raw session files.\n\nNo academic passage was removed because it showed substantial AI involvement, a correction, disagreement or an unsuccessful operation. Student identity, engineering reasoning, feedback, ordinary local paths, code and ordinary source links remain. Every difference between the selected readable source views and the concatenated public text is represented by a register entry. The untouched originals remain private.\n\n## Completeness boundary\n\n**ChatGPT is partial:** eleven retrieved conversations contain 82 message items. Fifteen reference-only assistant items still lack readable bodies; five explicitly truncated retrieval items have separately labeled browser supplements. Rendered browser text is not certified original Markdown. No official complete account export was supplied. The shared recovery session is not a third independent research session. System/developer instructions and internal reasoning were not rendered by the recovery process.\n\nThe archived range ends on October 29, 2026, before this public packaging was completed. Later interactions and this AI-assisted publication/validation step are not silently merged into earlier conversations. Hashes establish integrity of the available copies, not server authenticity, complete historical coverage or independent student execution. ---
name: computer-use
description: Control Windows apps from ChatGPT

# Computer Use

Use this skill to automate the UI of Microsoft Windows apps. It uses SendInput, UI Automation, and Windows.Graphics.Capture screenshots that work even when windows are occluded.

If this plugin is available, read this entire `SKILL.md` once before Windows automation work, before saying Computer Use is unavailable, and before falling back to other Windows automation.

Start with the directions in the Initialize section below. Read these bundled Markdown files relative to this `SKILL.md` when you need information about the specific topic they cover:

- `../../docs/guidance.md`: core runtime behavior, target-window workflow, screenshot handling, and recovery guidance. You MUST read this before controlling Windows apps.
- `../../docs/api.md`: full `sky` API reference. Read this when you need method signatures or object shapes.
- `../../docs/confirmations.md`: you MUST read this before deciding whether a Windows UI action needs confirmation

## Initialize

The bundled `cua_node` `@oai/sky` package is the core entry point for Computer Use. Import it directly by package name from the JavaScript session. Do not spawn `codex-computer-use.exe`, search for the helper executable, or build a custom helper protocol client.

Run this once per fresh `node_repl` JavaScript session:

```js
if (!globalThis.sky) {
  const { sky } = await import("@oai/sky");
  globalThis.sky = sky;
}
```

def export_database_subset(summaries):
 exports=[];coverage=[]
 db=HOME/'thread_history_1.sqlite'
 with sqlite3.connect(db.as_uri()+'?mode=ro',uri=True) as c:
  c.row_factory=sqlite3.Row;c.execute('PRAGMA query_only=ON');c.execute('BEGIN')
  for s in summaries:
   sid=s['session_id'];known=set(s['recorded_ui_item_ids'])
   item_path=OUT/'database_exports'/(sid+'.thread_items.jsonl')
   turn_path=OUT/'database_exports'/(sid+'.thread_turns.jsonl')
   missing=[];count=0
   with item_path.open('w',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n') as f:
    for row in c.execute('SELECT * FROM thread_items WHERE thread_id=? ORDER BY rollout_ordinal,created_at_ms,item_id',(sid,)):
     count+=1;data=dict(row);f.write(json.dumps(data,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
     if data['item_id'] not in known:missing.append({'export_line':count,**data})
   with turn_path.open('w',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n') as f:
    turns=0
    for row in c.execute('SELECT * FROM thread_turns WHERE thread_id=? ORDER BY rollout_ordinal',(sid,)):
     turns+=1;f.write(json.dumps(dict(row),ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
   exports.extend([{'file':item_path.relative_to(OUT).as_posix(),'source_database':str(db),'table':'thread_items','thread_id':sid,'logical_row_count':count,'snapshot_utc':NOW(),'method':'Read-only SELECT in a transaction; logical rows, not a byte-for-byte database copy'},
                   {'file':turn_path.relative_to(OUT).as_posix(),'source_database':str(db),'table':'thread_turns','thread_id':sid,'logical_row_count':turns,'snapshot_utc':NOW(),'method':'Read-only SELECT in a transaction; logical rows, not a byte-for-byte database copy'}])
   coverage.append({'session_id':sid,'cached_items':count,'cached_turns':turns,'cache_ids_not_in_rollout_ui_records':len(missing),
     'not_in_rollout_details':[{'item_id':m['item_id'],'rollout_ordinal':m['rollout_ordinal'],'item_type':m['item_type'],'database_export_line':m['export_line'],'after_rollout_snapshot':m['rollout_ordinal']>=s['records']} for m in missing]})
   if missing:
    dest=OUT/'shared'/('database_supplement_'+sid+'.md')
    with dest.open('w',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n') as f:
     f.write(f'# Local cache supplement\n\nSession `{sid}`. Source: `../{item_path.relative_to(OUT).as_posix()}`. These projection records have IDs not present in the archived rollout UI-record set. This does not by itself prove a lost interaction: projection IDs and an active snapshot boundary can differ. Records are not merged into the rollout chronology.\n\n')
     for item in missing:
      j=json.loads(item['item_json']);typ=j.get('type','');f.write(f'## Export line {item["export_line"]} · {typ} · {item["item_id"]}\n\n')
      if typ.lower() in ['reasoning','contextcompaction']:
       fence(f,json.dumps({'type':typ,'id':j.get('id'),'source_export_line':item['export_line']}),'json');continue
      if typ.lower() in ['usermessage','agentmessage']:
       fence(f,''.join(text_parts(j.get('content',[]))))
      else:fence(f,json.dumps(structured(j,f'{item_path.relative_to(OUT).as_posix()}#L{item["export_line"]}'),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),'json')
  c.rollback()
 dump(OUT/'metadata/database_exports.json',exports)
 dump(OUT/'metadata/database_coverage.json',coverage)
 return coverage


def main():

 snapshot_by_id={x['session_id']:x for x in snapshots}

 for sid in SESSIONS:

   snap=snapshot_source(Path(files[sid]['file']));snap['session_id']=sid;snapshots.append(snap);dump(journal,snapshots)
  else:

  print('Preserved source snapshot:',sid,'bytes:',snap['snapshot_bytes'],flush=True)
  summary,idx,privacy,contrib,gitlinks,checks=export_transcript(sid,snap,git_commits)
  summaries.append(summary);all_index+=idx;all_privacy+=privacy;all_contrib+=contrib;all_git+=gitlinks;all_text_checks+=checks
  print('Converted visible events:',sid,'message checks:',summary['counts'].get('message_text_checks'),'malformed:',len(summary['malformed_records']),flush=True)
 # Export database rows as a separately identified local evidence source.
 coverage=export_database_subset(summaries)
 # Preserve only relevant state/index metadata, not authentication or unrelated databases.
 with sqlite3.connect((HOME/'state_5.sqlite').as_uri()+'?mode=ro',uri=True) as c:
  c.row_factory=sqlite3.Row;rows=[dict(c.execute('SELECT * FROM threads WHERE id=?',(sid,)).fetchone()) for sid in SESSIONS]
 dump(OUT/'metadata/selected_thread_metadata.json',rows)
 source_index=[]
 for line in (HOME/'session_index.jsonl').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines():
  try:j=json.loads(line)
  except Exception:continue
  if j.get('id') in SESSIONS:source_index.append(j)
 dump(OUT/'metadata/selected_title_index_entries.json',source_index)
 # Fresh checks of each archived source against the corresponding original prefix.
 for snap in snapshots:
  p=Path(snap['source_path']);state=p.stat();snap['source_size_at_final_check']=state.st_size;snap['source_mtime_ns_at_final_check']=state.st_mtime_ns
  snap['archive_hash_matches']=sha(OUT/snap['archive_path'])==snap['sha256']
  snap['original_prefix_hash_still_matches']=sha(p,snap['snapshot_bytes'])==snap['sha256']
  snap['source_grew_after_snapshot']=state.st_size>snap['snapshot_bytes']
  snap['full_file_unchanged_during_snapshot_window']=state.st_size==snap['snapshot_bytes'] and state.st_mtime_ns==snap['source_mtime_ns_at_copy_start']
  assert snap['archive_hash_matches'] and snap['original_prefix_hash_still_matches']
 dump(journal,snapshots)
 after_stats={name:{'size':Path(name).stat().st_size,'mtime_ns':Path(name).stat().st_mtime_ns} for name in source_baseline}
 dump(OUT/'metadata/source_file_stats_after.json',after_stats)
 changed=[name for name in source_baseline if source_baseline[name]!=after_stats[name]]
 git_after=git_inventory();dump(OUT/'metadata/git_repositories_after.json',git_after)
 for before,after in zip(repos,git_after):
  assert before['head']==after['head'] and before['refs']==after['refs'] and before['tracked_worktree_status']==after['tracked_worktree_status'],before['path']
 index=[]
 for summary in summaries:
  sid=summary['session_id'];s=next(x for x in snapshots if x['session_id']==sid);m=files[sid]['meta']
  limitation=[]
# Public AI interaction evidence

This appendix supplies **available recovered conversations**, not only an AI-use summary. It is a separately authorized public derivative of privately preserved ChatGPT and Codex readable views. It retains available student instructions, AI proposals, corrections, errors, code and recorded tool outcomes in source order, with the specific redactions in the register. Original languages are preserved; translating or rewriting the dialogue would alter the evidence. New explanatory material is in English.

## Start here

- [Contribution-to-message links](contribution_links.md): 31 locators supporting the ten activities in the [contribution summary](../contribution_summary.csv).
- [Conversation index](conversation_index.csv): eleven ChatGPT conversations, three Codex session snapshots and one database-supplement notice. Each conversation has a README linking its numbered text parts.
- [Record index](record_index.csv): available message/event anchors with links to the public parts.
- [Redaction register](redactions.csv): one row for every removed span, with source character offsets, source text line, reason, replacement marker and public locator. Secret values and hashes of individual secrets are not published.
- [Integrity manifest](manifest.json): source-view fingerprints, public fingerprints and ordered part lists.
- [Source comparison](verification.json): recorded local comparison with all fifteen private source views.
- [Publication procedure and limits](publication_procedure.md).

The numbered `.txt` parts keep large tool logs readable on GitHub. Numbers indicate sequence, not editorial versions. Concatenating the parts **without adding separators** reconstructs each public derivative exactly. Historical links, version names and references to private files are retained as spoken; they are not current project references or downloadable public attachments. The archived source header's word “private” describes that original, not this public derivative.

## What was hidden

The register records **200 occurrences**: 5 password values, 5 literal password fragments in earlier checks, 82 access-token/signature/temporary access-key values, 23 restricted course-recording/meeting URLs and 85 inline image payloads. Occurrences include repeated representations and quoted tool output; they are not counts of unique credentials or independent conversations. Image bytes can contain unreviewed screenshots, including login screens; their surrounding tool text remains. This appendix does not publish binary attachments, browser HTML envelopes, raw databases or raw session files.

No academic passage was removed because it showed substantial AI involvement, a correction, disagreement or an unsuccessful operation. Student identity, engineering reasoning, feedback, ordinary local paths, code and ordinary source links remain. Every difference between the selected readable source views and the concatenated public text is represented by a register entry. The untouched originals remain private.

## Completeness boundary

**ChatGPT is partial:** eleven retrieved conversations contain 82 message items. Fifteen reference-only assistant items still lack readable bodies; five explicitly truncated retrieval items have separately labeled browser supplements. Rendered browser text is not certified original Markdown. No official complete account export was supplied. Missing replies are not reconstructed.

**Codex is a local snapshot:** two historical research sessions and one recovery/support session were preserved, with source timestamps and separate user/runtime-context/representation labels. The private audit recorded 231 tool-output truncation notices, including repeated representations; this is not a count of unique missing operations. The shared recovery session is not a third independent research session. The database supplement is a notice containing a reasoning-record identifier, not hidden reasoning text or an additional dialogue. System/developer instructions and internal reasoning were not rendered by the recovery process.

The archived range ends on October 29, 2026, before this public packaging was completed. Later interactions and this AI-assisted publication/validation step are not silently merged into earlier conversations. Hashes establish integrity of the available copies, not server authenticity, complete historical coverage or independent student execution. Providing this appendix improves disclosure, but **does not certify fulfillment of the course's entire-conversation requirement or instructor acceptance**.

## Validate

From the repository root, with Python 3.12 or newer:

```bash
python scripts/validate_ai_interactions.py
```

An authorized holder of the untouched recovered archives can additionally run the same script with `--originals /private/path/to/archives`. It verifies original fingerprints and reconstructs every public text by replacing exactly the registered source spans. It reads the private originals locally and does not upload them or print removed values. No institutional login is needed for the public appendix.
